name: progress-panel
description: A pane beside every Claude Code chat showing the progress of every session on the machine, grouped by session

progressDir.title: Progress folder
progressDir.description: Folder every session writes its status file to. Empty = progress/ in the Claude config directory (~/.claude/progress). ~/ expands to your home directory.

autoClearDoneHours.title: Auto-clear done tasks after (hours)
autoClearDoneHours.description: Done and skipped tasks older than this are cleared, and so are subagents that finished that long ago. 0 = never.

keepEndedSessionsDays.title: Keep ended sessions (days)
keepEndedSessionsDays.description: An ended session is removed this many days after it ended. 0 = keep until dismissed.

ciCommand.title: Custom CI command
ciCommand.description: For a CI the panel has no built-in support for (Jenkins, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps, Woodpecker…): a command that prints a pipeline's status as JSON (format in the README). Placeholders {project}, {id}, {sha}, {host}, each filled inside its own argument; no shell; ~/ expands to your home. Empty = off.

paneColumns.title: Sidebar width (columns)
paneColumns.description: How wide the pane opens when docked beside a fullscreen chat (Claude Code caps it at 45% of the terminal; dragging its edge wins). 0 = Claude Code's default.

paneRows.title: Height above the prompt (rows)
paneRows.description: How tall the pane opens when a narrow terminal shows it full width above the prompt (dragging it wins). 0 = Claude Code's default (a third).

sortTasksBy.title: Sort tasks by
sortTasksBy.description: The starting order; the pane's Sort button changes it.

autoStart.title: Start in every new session
autoStart.description: on: every new session reports to the pane from the start. off: the panel loads but stays dormant (no reporting rule, no reminders, no automatic watches, the pane does not open by itself) until /progress on or the pane's switch turns it on for that session.

tasksDefault.title: Task lists in new sessions
tasksDefault.description: off: sessions report only what they are doing (now) and what needs you, no task list. /progress tasks on|off overrides it per session.

agentsDefault.title: Subagent reporting in new sessions
agentsDefault.description: off: subagents are not asked to report and their reports are ignored. /progress agents on|off overrides it per session.

pipelinesDefault.title: Pipelines in new sessions
pipelinesDefault.description: off: pushes are not watched and the agent's watch is ignored. /progress pipelines on|off overrides it per session.

autoNeedsPermission.title: Needs you: permission prompts
autoNeedsPermission.description: on: a session waiting on a permission prompt shows it under Needs you (naming the subagent that asks) until it is answered.

autoNeedsIdle.title: Needs you: waiting for your reply
autoNeedsIdle.description: on: a session waiting for your reply shows it under Needs you until you answer.

toastNeedsYou.title: Toast other sessions' asks
toastNeedsYou.description: on: a new Needs-you ask of another session is toasted.

bell.title: Also notify through the terminal
bell.description: on: a toast is also sent through your terminal's notification channel (its bell or banner — Claude Code's preferredNotifChannel).

pipelineNotify.title: A watched pipeline finishing
pipelineNotify.description: Toast it never, only when it failed, or always.

paneScope.title: Sessions the pane lists
paneScope.description: all; only the sessions in this session's repo; or this session only. Applies to the list, Needs you, the toasts and the status line.

autoOpen.title: Open the pane by itself
autoOpen.description: auto: a session opens it (Claude Code shows it from ~144 columns); never: only /progress or the pane's command opens it.

doneShown.title: Finished tasks shown
doneShown.description: How many finished tasks an open Done lists before folding the rest behind 'N older'.

agentsShown.title: Finished agents shown
agentsShown.description: How many finished subagents an open Done lists before 'N older'.

successFoldHours.title: Fold successful pipelines after (hours)
successFoldHours.description: A successful pipeline older than this moves into the folded 'Finished' row.

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: How times read: 24-hour, 12-hour, or as your system's locale says.

reportingEffort.title: Reporting effort
reportingEffort.description: detailed: every step (today's rule); milestones: the plan, each task done or blocked, Needs you — fewer calls; minimal: only what it is doing and Needs you. Subagents follow it too.

planGate.title: Subagents post their plan first
planGate.description: on: a subagent that has made this many tool calls (the next setting) without posting its steps through progress_update has its next call refused once, with the instruction to post them (a minimal reporting effort asks only for `now`). off: no refusal; the reminders still come.

planGateCalls.title: Tool calls before the plan is due
planGateCalls.description: How many tool calls a subagent may make before its plan must be in the pane (a job of about this size needs none); the main session is reminded once in a turn at twice this many calls without a task list.

updateEveryCalls.title: Remind after tool calls without an update
updateEveryCalls.description: A subagent that has made this many tool calls since its last progress_update is reminded with its next tool result, naming the step still `doing`; the main session at twice this. milestones doubles it, minimal turns it off. 0 = off.

updateEveryMin.title: Remind after minutes without an update
updateEveryMin.description: The same reminder after this many minutes without an update (subagents). milestones doubles it, minimal turns it off. 0 = off.

settleBeforeHandback.title: Steps settled before a subagent hands back
settleBeforeHandback.description: on: a subagent that hands back (or stops) with steps still todo/doing is refused once with the list to close; the next attempt passes, and the plugin marks what is left unfinished. Not relaxed by the reporting effort.

pipelineRefreshSec.title: Pipeline refresh (seconds)
pipelineRefreshSec.description: How often watched pipelines are asked after (through your own glab / gh / tea).

updateCheck.title: Check for a newer release
updateCheck.description: on: the pane looks for a newer release at most every 6 h (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC turns it off regardless).

palette.title: Colours
palette.description: default; colour-blind safe (blue for success, orange for failure); or no colour.

runningPipelineX.title: Pipeline ⊘ stop button (running pipelines)
runningPipelineX.description: What the red ⊘ stop button beside a running pipeline does (two presses): delete = cancel it and delete it from the CI (GitLab, GitHub); cancel = only cancel it; off = the ⊘ button is hidden. The ✕ beside it only hides the row and never touches the CI.
